steps.task: Fill the result list using this topic's rule.
hints: Treat readings as a row of stamps. Keep a stack, which is a pile where you can add or remove only the top stamp. Read the stamps from left to right. If the next stamp matches the top stamp, remove the top stamp and do not add the new one. Otherwise, put the new stamp on top. The result list is the final stack, from bottom to top.
Revisit the example and copy one instruction at a time, checking what it does.
